name: cato
description: Cuts Claude Code's token cost with context and prompt-cache control, automatic compaction, compression of noisy output and efficient code navigation, with Serena, Graphify, ast-grep and GitHub MCP integration. Speaks English, Portuguese and Spanish.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of CATO's reports, warnings and status line: auto, en, pt or es. auto follows Claude Code's `language` setting, then the system locale; unsupported languages fall back to English.

guard.title: Context and cache guard
guard.description: Warns when the context crosses the configured bands and holds the prompt once when the cache expired and continuing would be expensive.

guardBlockUsd.title: Minimum cost to hold the prompt (USD)
guardBlockUsd.description: With an expired cache, the prompt is held only if rewriting the context costs at least this much. 0 turns holding off (warning only).

contextWarn.title: Context warning bands (tokens)
contextWarn.description: Comma-separated list. Each band warns once per session (again after /compact).

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache duration (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 60 on a subscription (1h TTL); 5 with an API key.

autoCompactPercent.title: Auto-compact at (% of the window)
autoCompactPercent.description: Compacts before the next prompt when the context passes this share of the window. 0 turns it off.

blockHeavyReads.title: Block heavy reads
blockHeavyReads.description: Denies reading node_modules, dist, build, coverage, .next, target, venvs, lockfiles and minified bundles.

compressShell.title: Compress noisy shell output
compressShell.description: Tests, linters, installs, builds and container logs. Data output is never changed.

disableForks.title: Avoid subagent forks
disableForks.description: A fork copies the whole conversation into the subagent; CATO asks for a subagent with a clean context instead.

pythonChecks.title: Use Python when available
pythonChecks.description: Exact syntax check of .py files after edits, only if Python is installed. Without Python, nothing changes.

serenaMaxAnswerChars.title: Serena: answer limit (characters)
serenaMaxAnswerChars.description: Applied to Serena's read tools when the model does not ask for a limit (max_answer_chars). Above it, Serena asks for a narrower query. 0 turns it off.

astGrepMaxResults.title: ast-grep: maximum matches
astGrepMaxResults.description: Default result limit for structural search (mcp__cato__structural_search and the ast-grep MCP's find_code). 0 turns it off.

compactGithub.title: GitHub MCP: compact responses
compactGithub.description: Strips JSON fields only API clients need (API URLs, node_id, avatars, full user objects) and lockfile diffs.

subagentCacheTtlMinutes.title: Subagent cache duration (minutes)
subagentCacheTtlMinutes.description: 5 by default, even on a subscription. Use 60 only if you set subagentPromptCacheTtl=1h in Claude Code.

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: What the summary should keep when nobody gave instructions (auto-compaction, /compact with no text). Empty turns it off; the text of your /compact always wins.
compactInstructions.default: Keep the current goal and the user's open requests; the decisions made and why; the paths of changed files; errors and failing tests with the exact message; and the next steps. Do not reproduce file contents, tool output or logs: cite paths and CATO's #cmd_/#sbx_ IDs. Be concise and write the summary in the conversation's language.

readGuard.title: Outline on large reads (experimental)
readGuard.description: A full Read of a code file over 60 KB first gets the outline with each declaration's lines; asking again lets it through. /cato shows how often it was requested again.

maskColdCompact.title: Mask old results when compacting with a cold cache (experimental)
maskColdCompact.description: With an expired cache, large tool results outside the last 10 exchanges become one line before the summary. With a warm cache nothing changes.

sandboxMinTokens.title: MCP sandbox: minimum size (tokens)
sandboxMinTokens.description: MCP responses above this become a searchable sandbox with the start and end shown. Repeating the same call brings it whole. App, terminal and browser tools are never sandboxed.

sandboxSkip.title: MCP sandbox: tools always whole (regex)
sandboxSkip.description: Regular expression over the tool name (e.g. mcp__clickup__|mcp__notion__). Matching tools always come back whole.

warmCache.title: Keep the cache warm during short pauses (experimental)
warmCache.description: With a large context and the session idle, one small call shortly before the cache expires keeps it warm (at most 2 per pause). /cato shows what it cost and what it saved.
